calculations.original_public_message: Taking the segregated cash amounts ($25.0B for 2010 and $24.0B for 2009) together with the fair value of segregated securities ($9.7B for 2010 and $10.2B for 2009), I will compute each year's total fair value.
For 2009, segregated cash was $24.0B and securities fair value was $10.2B. I will add them to get the 2009 total.
